# YourPods

> YourPods is a gPodder-compatible, privacy-first, self-hosted podcast player for iOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, and Apple Watch. Sync your subscriptions and listening progress across all your devices using your own Nextcloud server. Version 1.3.0.

## Project Info

- [README](README.md): Main documentation and feature overview
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Developer guide and contribution rules
- [License](LICENSE): GNU General Public License v3.0

## Core Features

- **Apple Ecosystem**: Optimized for iOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, and CarPlay with native integrations.
- **Privacy**: No tracking, analytics, or ads. Fully self-hosted sync via Nextcloud/gPodder.
- **Multi-Profile**: Switch between different servers or user accounts instantly. Local-only accounts supported.
- **Sync Conflict Management**: Smart conflict resolution with options to keep local state or overwrite from server.
- **Last Synced Timestamp**: Displays the last sync time in settings for transparency.

## Player & Audio

- **Audio Engine 2.0**: Rewritten audio handling resolving Bluetooth dropouts and improving stability.
- **Live Transcripts**: Interactive, searchable transcripts with auto-scroll.
- **Smart Chapters**: Embedded chapter support (RSS and ID3 tag-based) for easy navigation.
- **Smart Queue**: Drag-and-drop reordering with "Now Playing" and "Up Next" sections, visible episode lengths, "Move to Top/Bottom" quick actions.
- **Precision Control**: Granular playback speed slider and custom sleep timers.
- **Mini Player**: Persistent playback controls across the app.
- **Listening Stats**: Local listening history tracking.

## Discovery

- **Unified Search**: Defaults to iTunes for extensive coverage, with optional PodcastIndex support (requires personal API key).
- **Add to Server**: Discover new podcasts in-app and instantly sync subscriptions to your self-hosted server.
- **Metadata Caching**: Configurable cache duration for faster load times.
- **Background Refresh**: Automatic episode fetching in the background.

## Platform Integrations

- **CarPlay**: Full queue management and playback control with native UI, optimized template updates.
- **Apple Watch**: Standalone playback, offline episode transfer, and haptic controls.
- **Apple TV (tvOS)**: Universal purchase support across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Watch, and TV.
- **Dynamic Island**: Real-time playback status via Live Activities on supported iPhones.
- **Siri Support**: Voice commands for hands-free playback.

## Technical

- **Tech Stack**: Flutter 3.10+, Provider for state management, Just Audio + Audio Service for playback.
- **Sync Backend**: Optimized for the gpodder-sync Nextcloud app. Standard gPodder services may work but are not the primary focus.
- **Protocol**: Implements the Open Podcast Sync protocol for subscriptions (SubscriptionDelta) and actions (EpisodeAction).
- **Storage**: flutter_secure_storage for credentials, Hive/SQLite for local database and offline capability.
- **Native Code**: CarPlay (Swift), watchOS (SwiftUI), tvOS (SwiftUI), iOS Live Activities.
- **Key Dependencies**: just_audio, audio_service, flutter_carplay, dio, live_activities, watch_connectivity, background_fetch, dart_rss.

## Architecture

- `lib/api/` - Nextcloud/gPodder API integration
- `lib/models/` - Data models (Podcast, Episode, etc.)
- `lib/providers/` - State management (Provider pattern)
- `lib/screens/` - UI screens (Player, Library, Settings, Search, History, Queue, Playlists, Profile Selection)
- `lib/services/` - Core services (Audio, CarPlay, Chapters, Live Activities, Siri, Transcripts, Watch, Background Refresh, Listening Stats)
- `lib/widgets/` - Reusable UI components
- `lib/utils/` - Utility functions
